If this branch has more judgeable work coming, there is a third route: carry the fix into the NEXT chunk's commit. That is NOT the deferral warned against above — deferring to a later ROUND buys a second round; riding a commit that is being made anyway buys none. Write it where that chunk will meet it (the build plan or `.prawduct/.handoff-notes.md`), or it is not a deferral, it is a drop.
